name: Cheat Manager
description: Add, edit, toggle, delete and import RetroArch cheats (.cht) for your games, right on your device.
author: Thomas Fournier

changelog.Unreleased: Miyoo Flip (my355): the pak now ships a libSDL2_gfx that works with the glibc 2.28 of its firmware (the bundled one needed glibc 2.29 and the pak could not start). Anbernic (h700): libSDL2_ttf is now bundled, as the Pak Store does. These platforms and tg5050 are still experimental (not tested on hardware).
changelog.v1.1.0:
Installing from the Pak Store works: the release zip now holds the pak at its root (it was nested one folder too deep and the pak did not start). Installing by hand: unzip, name the folder Cheat Manager.pak and copy it into Tools/tg5040.
Add support for tg5050 (TrimUI Smart Pro), h700 (Anbernic) and my355 (Miyoo Flip) platforms.
changelog.v1.0.1:
First release:
- Add, edit, enable/disable and delete the cheats of a game, right on the device.
- Import cheats from local .cht files or from a URL.
- Interface in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese, chosen on first launch.
